title: Weights Harmonizer: ingest, deterministic conversion, and performance-profile emission
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a deterministic intake sub-pipeline that: 1) verifies cryptographic manifests for incoming community weights, 2) normalizes binary artifacts into a canonical runtime-friendly packaging (quantized variants, attention-cache map), and 3) emits a signed, versioned performance profile to the model catalog. This work closes gaps where numeric nondeterminism in conversion caused profile flakiness and incorrect pin recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New weights batches processed by the harmonizer produce identical checksumed artifacts across two independent runs on staging. 2) Conversion artifacts include a metadata file with: original_manifest_sha256, converter_version, quant_profile_id, deterministic_seed. 3) Performance profile publish task appears on catalog with stable latency/P50/P95 values within expected tolerance. 4) Canary rollout automates pinning to the staging runtime for 10% traffic without degraded SLOs.
technical_notes:
- Use OCI-compatible tarball with layered manifest for artifact packaging.
- Conversion jobs must run inside the conversion container (gcr.io/redwood/converter:v3) with a fixed RNG seed and CPU affinity to reduce nondeterminism.
- Capture fp32->int8 quantization parameters and store numeric checksum file for each tensor blob.
- Extend profile schema with fields: sample_sequence_distribution, batch_latency_histogram_bucket_meta, kv-cache-warmup-cost.
- Add a verification step: rehydrate converted artifact and run a deterministic micro-smoke using a precommitted input set (see links).
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): process historical 25 sample models through the harmonizer and validate checksums (2 engineers, 2 days). Phase 2 (canary): publish profiles and route 10% of internal test traffic to pinned variants for 72h. Phase 3 (gradual): increase to 50% then 100% once metrics stable. Rollback via catalog tag revert and model fallback policy.
test_plan:
- Unit: conversion container byte-level checksums for small synthetic checkpoint.
- Integration: run harmonizer on 25 representative OSS models (small/med/long-context) and compare profile stability across runs.
- E2E smoke: KV-cache warmup benchmark + latency regression check using runtime staging clusters.
- Load: 10% canary traffic simulated with perf harness for 72h.
